title: pc01-kubelet-guardrails
description:
pc01 (x86 GPU worker, Talos v1.13.3) repeatedly dies under resource pressure (see .agents/postmortems/2026-08-18-pc01-containerd-pleg-dead/PM.md: containerd hang -> PLEG death -> NotReady, trigger unknown). Goal: kubelet detects pressure and evicts pods / stops admitting BEFORE system daemons starve.
Edit nostos/templates/talos-pc01.yaml kubelet section (currently only sets image ghcr.io/siderolabs/kubelet:v1.32.1):
- evictionHard: memory.available<10%, nodefs.available<15%, imagefs.available<15%
- evictionSoft with matching thresholds + grace intervals
- kubeReserved and systemReserved (cpu/memory/ephemeral-storage) sized sensibly for this box
Validate keys against the Talos v1.13 machineconfig kubelet config schema (docs or nostos source in .submodules/nostos).
Validate by running `nostos render pc01` (writes gitignored nostos/state/configs/ - NEVER commit that dir). Do NOT run `nostos apply`. Do not touch other node templates.
ACCEPTANCE: Diff committed on branch; `nostos render pc01` succeeds; rendered machineconfig contains the new kubelet eviction/reserved settings; no other templates modified. Evidence in tk comment.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
DONE: kubelet eviction + reserved guardrails on talos-pc01 (commit 294e2a3f, branch pc01-kubelet-guardrails, +31 lines, only nostos/templates/talos-pc01.yaml touched).

WHAT: added machine.kubelet.extraConfig (VM is 4 vCPU / 12GiB / 30GiB):
- systemReserved: cpu 150m / memory 512Mi / ephemeral-storage 1Gi (OS daemons: tailscaled, hostDNS, apid; matches tp1/tp4/dell01 precedent)
- kubeReserved: cpu 200m / memory 1Gi / ephemeral-storage 2Gi (kubelet+containerd; caps kubepods cgroup ~1.5GiB below capacity — headroom for the containerd that wedged in the PM)
- evictionSoft 15%/20%/20% + evictionSoftGracePeriod 1m30s (memory) / 2m (fs): fires BEFORE hard, graceful pod eviction with slack remaining
- evictionHard 10%/15%/15% per spec: last-resort immediate kill before system daemons starve
Note on 'evictionSoft with matching thresholds': identical values would make soft dead config (hard evicts instantly at the same threshold, grace never applies), so soft sits above hard — that's what makes the grace intervals functional and implements 'detect pressure BEFORE starvation'.

SCHEMA VALIDATION (keys are Unstructured under extraConfig in v1.13, so verified directly against ground truth):
1. Talos v1.13.3 pkg/machinery/config/types/v1alpha1/v1alpha1_types.go: extraConfig accepted; kubelet.ProtectedConfigurationFields does NOT include any of the five keys.
2. kubelet v1.32.1 (exact image on pc01) KubeletConfiguration v1beta1 types.go: evictionHard/evictionSoft/evictionSoftGracePeriod/kubeReserved/systemReserved all confirmed as map[string]string json tags.
3. talosctl validate --config <rendered> --mode metal: PASS.

RENDER VALIDATION — node key correction:  targets the bare-metal Proxmox host and prints 'installs no machineconfig'; the machineconfig node is talos-pc01 (template talos-pc01.yaml). comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
APPROVED: all four review criteria verified independently (Validator-lyf, one pass).

(1) SCOPE — commit 294e2a3f == branch pc01-kubelet-guardrails HEAD, worktree clean; branch diff vs main is exactly nostos/templates/talos-pc01.yaml +31/-0, one hunk inside machine.kubelet (between nodeIP and network keys, correctly nested as kubelet.extraConfig sibling). No other templates touched.

(2) SCHEMA — checked against cited ground truth myself (Go module cache, exact versions, not the worker's word): k8s.io/kubelet@v0.32.1 config/v1beta1/types.go lines 520/525/530/644/652: evictionHard, evictionSoft, evictionSoftGracePeriod, systemReserved, kubeReserved all map[string]string with exactly those json tags. siderolabs/talos pkg/machinery@v1.13.3: KubeletExtraConfig Unstructured yaml:\extraConfig\ (v1alpha1_types.go:731) accepts arbitrary object; ProtectedConfigurationFields (kubelet/kubelet.go) = [apiVersion authentication authorization cgroupRoot kind kubeletCgroups port protectKernelDefaults resolvConf rotateCertificates systemCgroups staticPodPath seccompDefault] — none of the five keys protected, so all are overridable via extraConfig. Threshold ordering sane: soft strictly above hard (15%>10%, 20%>15%, 20%>15%) so soft fires first and the grace periods (1m30s mem / 2m fs) are functional, hard is last-resort.

(3) RENDER REPRO — 1Password still locked ('account is not signed in'), so per review scope: stubbed op on PATH returning fixed dummy base64 for any 'op read' + temp config copy without the secrets.tailscale block (tailscale://authkey passes through unresolved — internal/secrets/backend.go ResolveTemplate ignores schemes with no registered backend; only secret VALUES differ, structure is what is judged). Template copied to ~/.nostos-tklyf, sha256-verified byte-identical to the git blob at 294e2a3f (0e8daccd...458c0). 'nostos render talos-pc01' -> 'Rendered ~/.local/share/nostos/configs/bc-24-11-45-72-b6.yaml' exit 0 (render's built-in talosctl validate gates the success line); independent 'talosctl validate --config <out> --mode metal' -> 'is valid for metal mode'. Rendered kubelet.extraConfig contains all five settings with exact intended values. Node-key correction re-confirmed first-hand: 'nostos render pc01' -> 'proxmox installs no machineconfig; nothing to render for pc01'. Note: my first stub emitted malformed base64 and talosctl validate REJECTED the render — the validate gate demonstrably bites, so the passing run is meaningful.

(4) RESERVE SIZING — 4 vCPU/12GiB/30GiB VM: systemReserved+kubeReserved totals 350m CPU (8.75%), 1.5GiB memory (12.5%), 3GiB ephemeral-storage (10%) -> allocatable ~3.65 vCPU / ~10.5GiB for GPU workloads: protective, not starving. Hard memory eviction floor 10% (~1GiB) gives kubelet room to shed pods well before the containerd-starvation mode from PM 2026-08-18.

Evidence: .agents/match/validations/tk-lyf-render-validate.txt, tk-lyf-rendered-kubelet.txt, tk-lyf-schema-verify.txt. Browser validation N/A — change is nostos CLI/template only, no web surface. Post-review runtime steps (not blockers): true-secrets 'nostos render talos-pc01' once 1Password is unlocked (expected identical modulo secret values), then plan 2.2 apply.
